baseline.statement: No enactor existed before this wave, so the rung opens at zero. Any later count is the number of lessons whose form a machine ran, measured by running it.

ladder.definition: A machine named the structural form the lesson asks a class to move through, ran that form's moves on the lesson's own inputs, and produced a scene or a printed record together with a verdict. It is not a claim that a discussion occurred; each emitted row carries its own sentence about what it does not claim.

refusals.machine_needed: A center-activity enactor that reads a named center from the center descriptions and runs its turn structure over the stage the lesson names.
A reader that takes a drawn number line and returns its tick sequence, so a mislabelled line can be checked against the sequence it should carry.
The same drawn-line reader, returning the interval endpoints, so a point with no printed scale can be bracketed.
A reader for the supplied race map, since every distance in the task is a position on a map this module never receives.

A partition machine over a drawn interval that reports whether the marks cut equal parts, which the fraction partition automaton does not do because it partitions a supplied whole rather than reading a drawn one.
A locate-the-unit machine that finds where 1 sits on a line whose only printed marks are unit fractions; the numerals live in the figure the markdown drops.
A table reader for the 25-cell fraction grid; the fractions are printed in the figure and the row and column structure is not in the markdown.
A card-set reader for the teacher-supplied expression cards, and the fraction lane this wave leaves closed.
